commit 54f094f1de9065f17b823e93cb227c59934cce0e
Author:     John Bieling <john@thunderbird.net>
AuthorDate: Sat Jul 4 17:10:01 2026 +0000
Commit:     john@thunderbird.net <john@thunderbird.net>
CommitDate: Sat Jul 4 17:12:09 2026 +0000

    Bug 1767958 - Wait for the content tab to finish loading before starting the extension in browser_ext_menus_replace_menu_context.js. r=arschmitz
    
    overrideContext_with_context opens an example.com content tab, then starts an
    extension whose tab.js runs tabs.query({url: "https://example.com/?SomeTab"}).
    awaitBrowserLoaded(browser) was called without a target URL, so it only waited
    for readyState "complete" and could resolve on a pre-swap/intermediate state
    (loading https content into a mail tab triggers a remoteness switch/browser
    swap). The extension then queried before the tab had committed the URL -> empty
    result -> tab.js threw "tab is undefined" before sending "setup_ready" -> the
    test timed out.
    
    Pass the expected URL to awaitBrowserLoaded so it waits until the content tab
    has committed https://example.com/?SomeTab before the extension runs.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D310471

diff --git a/mail/components/extensions/test/browser/browser_ext_menus_replace_menu_context.js b/mail/components/extensions/test/browser/browser_ext_menus_replace_menu_context.js
index c0b6444accc..0707fdd434a 100644
--- a/mail/components/extensions/test/browser/browser_ext_menus_replace_menu_context.js
+++ b/mail/components/extensions/test/browser/browser_ext_menus_replace_menu_context.js
@@ -236,7 +236,7 @@ add_task(async function overrideContext_with_context() {
   });
 
   const { browser } = window.openContentTab("https://example.com/?SomeTab");
-  await awaitBrowserLoaded(browser);
+  await awaitBrowserLoaded(browser, "https://example.com/?SomeTab");
 
   const otherExtension = ExtensionTestUtils.loadExtension({
     manifest: {
